scope: Existing Python API static geometry component; not desktop or full route-planner acceptance

query.selection: Lexicographically first of the unchanged 193 source-positive annotation voxels
query.geometry: Declared mathematical two-capsule static probe: 0.25 mm radii, 2 mm centerline length, 0.5 mm distal segment; normalized reference-affine first column supplies the axis. No measured commercial instrument claim.

measured_result.control_meaning: Intentional checker-scene software ablation only. Empty modeled exclusions are not actual negative anatomy, safe tissue, a replacement case or a surgical demonstration.

binding.source_frame: Explicit retrospective source_reference_grid_normalization; scanner and interscan alignment remain unaccepted

resources.rss_enforcement: Observed RSS watchdog approximately every 0.1 seconds plus final worker ru_maxrss check; no instantaneous kernel RSS enforcement claimed
resources.decoded_source_scope: Existing builder validates the original structural array and manual mask. Full MRI decoding was necessary for canonical CaseData and its exact content binding; streamed SHA256 and no additional scalar decoding for the control.

interpretation: Actual source-bound positive aneurysm annotation changed the shared geometry checker response. This resolves the positive existing-API kernel-consumption demonstration for this declared query only.
remaining_gap: A bound planning/desktop probe entry is still absent. Route APIs continue to require genuine target/access evidence, which this source component does not supply. Preserve those guards; do not substitute a tumor compartment or access support.
unproved: Glioma efficacy, full vessel avoidance, expert approval of this adaptation, anatomical accuracy, scanner/navigation alignment, safe surgical routes, vascular consequences, outcomes and generalization. Motor/language, unannotated cells and anatomy outside the image remain unknown.
